items.risk: Reported growth includes meaningful acquisition/disposition and FX effects; organic growth is materially lower than reported growth.
Tariff recoveries and favorable FX contributed to margin expansion, while debt and acquisition integration remain execution sensitivities.
General-purpose cameras, mobile devices and competing machine-vision stacks can substitute for portions of the portfolio, so integration/workflow depth matters to resilience.
Acquisition integration and intangible amortization can obscure underlying operating improvement and consume management capacity.
Global hardware exposure creates tariff, FX, component availability and supplier disruption sensitivity.
Rapid AI/machine-vision evolution creates competitive response and obsolescence risk even as it expands the market.

contradictions.contradiction: Record margins include $73M of IEEPA tariff recoveries, so the full magnitude of margin expansion should not be treated as purely underlying operating improvement.
Acquisitions expand the technology stack but can make reported growth look stronger than organic adoption; strategic breadth and organic traction must remain separate.

Record adjusted profitability is directionally supported by growth and productivity but its magnitude is temporarily amplified by tariff recoveries and FX; the underlying improvement is therefore positive but smaller than the headline expansion.
